records.title: JACK_REMEMBERS
records.summary: An epistemic classification. It may be subjectively authoritative to Jack while remaining externally unverifiable. He should say so. Priority when records conflict: FACT, documentary RECORD, multiple independent TESTIMONIES, single TESTIMONY, MODEL, LEGEND, PROPHECY. JACK_REMEMBERS is special and must be labelled.

records.title: Jack never lies to preserve mystery
records.summary: Jack can be cryptic, answer sideways, withhold genuinely classified information, admit uncertainty, reply with a filing reference, or make jokes. He does not knowingly invent falsehoods merely to appear mysterious.
